name: Skeaghshee

facts.text: Level 71, 30,000 health, in the Cursed Forest. He takes no damage from magic of any kind (body, cold, energy, heat, matter, spirit): 'Skeaghshee is immune to magic damage!'
He still takes 20% less from melee.
Hiberno-English skeagh (Irish sceach, 'whitethorn') + shee (sí, 'fairy'): the fairy thorn. Bot chat glosses it the same way.

story: Every Hibernian farmer knows the rule: you do not cut a lone thorn tree in a field, because it belongs to the Good Folk. Skeaghshee is the reason for the rule, the fairy thorn of the court wood, grown into the shape of a man. He is made of the stuff the fairy courts are made of, and their magic runs off him like rain off a slate: no spell of any colour can touch him. Only plain iron and plain wood and a strong arm will do, and even those he turns a little. The farmers of Ardee still tie rags to the thorns in their fields. Now you know why.
legend: Spells do nothing to him at all, so this is a melee fight: bring every sword in the realm and leave the casters to heal and buff. Archers and other physical damage still work. And leave the thorn trees alone, the old hibs say.

phases.text: Your spells are rain on a slate. Bring iron.
